channel.title: Lucas Hudson — Blog
channel.description: Notes from Berlin on data science, local AI, open-source models, and building software that runs on your own machine.

item.title: Maybe AI needs a regulated profession behind it
item.description: Almost anyone can deploy AI that makes big decisions about people with no profession in the middle. Three recent Australian stories show why I think we need registered AI engineers.

item.title: NVIDIA GTC Golden Ticket Winner: wave~reader
item.description: I won an NVIDIA GTC Golden Ticket challenge with wave~reader — an agentic surf forecaster for 238 Australian breaks with deterministic scoring narrated by NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra.

item.title: I Hate React and JS
item.description: Why a Python-first data scientist should reach for HTMX and FastAPI before another React course.

item.title: Movie Club: My First Deployed Full-Stack Web App
item.description: A server-rendered FastAPI app that runs a monthly film competition for friends — built without a line of React.

item.title: Deutsch Class: Fully Local German Vocabulary Trainer
item.description: A Postgres-backed vocabulary trainer with a Textual TUI, macOS text-to-speech, and on-device Whisper pronunciation scoring.

item.title: Berlin - Blog Refresh
item.description: Leaving Melbourne for Berlin, resetting the blog, and setting the terms for the projects that come next.
